pe_rule: Aggregate index market capitalisation divided by aggregate adjusted trailing-four-quarter earnings. Constituent profits and losses are both included. If aggregate index earnings are non-positive, reconstructed P/E is not publishable.
pb_rule: Aggregate index market capitalisation divided by aggregate adjusted annual net worth/book value. Constituent net-worth contributions are aggregated with the same index adjustment factors as market capitalisation; no positive-constituent-P/B prefilter is allowed.
dy_rule: Aggregate rolling-12-month equity dividends divided by aggregate index market capitalisation, using ex-dividend dates and the same index adjustment factors.
historical_weight_identity: If w_i is the actual published historical index weight and M_i is the matching unadjusted company market capitalisation, then w_i*(E_i/M_i), w_i*(B_i/M_i), and w_i*(D_i/M_i) recover the index-adjusted denominator/numerator yields because the unknown IWF/capping factor cancels into the published weight.
required_company_inputs: point-in-time eligible annual net worth/book value (signed if reported)
prohibited_shortcuts: rejecting a constituent solely because its TTM earnings are negative
dropping loss-making constituents from the P/E denominator
requiring every constituent P/E or P/B to be positive before aggregation
replacing signed earnings or net worth with zero
publishing a positive index P/E when aggregate adjusted index earnings are non-positive
promotion_rule: Research algebra only. It cannot alter V3.13 or promote any historical result without a fully point-in-time 50/50 reconstruction and a predeclared recent-regime reproduction tolerance.
